salience_continuous._note: Phase 2 (PRD R2.3): a continuous 'evidence richness' lever so salience discriminates even at mention_count=1. MULTIPLICATIVE on the base: salience = base*(1 + weight*richness) + retrieval_boost, richness in [0,1]. Multiplicative (not additive) so it spreads the populated salience bands WITHOUT lifting genuinely-low items over the archive/decay thresholds (those thresholds stay valid — R2.4 satisfied by construction; percentile thresholds remain a future hardening). Primary lever source_breadth (distinct source_conversations); key_insights + related_links + a recency tiebreaker add present-day variance while mention_count is ~1 pre-dedup.

tier_percentiles._note: Phase 3 (PRD R3.1/R3.2): tier from salience percentile, not static context_type. Top tier_1_top_pct of active entries -> Tier 1, next tier_2_next_pct -> Tier 2, remainder -> Tier 3. identity_floor_context_types can never fall below Tier 2 (durable identity/explicit saves aren't demoted by a quiet stretch). Operator decision (PRD open Q#2).

dream_thresholds._phase4_note: R4.1 scheduled_archive_limit ramped 10->50 (tripwire guards spikes; raise toward 100 as M5 confirms prune>=intake). R4.2 isArchiveCandidate broadened to any zero-access single-source low-salience entry EXCEPT archive_protected_context_types. R4.3 layer2_quarantine_salience now policy-driven. Phase fix 2.8: archive_candidate_min_age_days=14 prevents fresh low-salience entries from being archived on night one. Phase fix 2.5: max_entries_touched_per_apply caps total distinct entry IDs across all ops so duplicate_merge archive_ids cannot bypass the per-op archive cap.

dedup._tuning_note: COSINE_DUP_THRESHOLD raised 0.86->0.95 from the 2026-05-29 sweep: 0.86 chained a 1980-member mega-cluster; 0.95 yields tight 2-6 clusters with the size guard splitting the rest to lexical. Operator decision (PRD open Q#1) — retune as needed.
